python3 -c "
# Values in millions of dollars
jan_1980 = -4559
feb_1980 = -9346

# Calculate absolute percentage change
# Formula: |(new - old) / old| * 100
absolute_change = abs(feb_1980 - jan_1980)
percentage_change = (absolute_change / abs(jan_1980)) * 100

print(f'January 1980: {jan_1980} million')
print(f'February 1980: {feb_1980} million')
print(f'Absolute change: {absolute_change} million')
print(f'Percentage change: {percentage_change:.2f}%')
"
